blocks.text: WASHINGTON — The prison chief in the southern US state of Tennessee has resigned, the governor said Saturday, after an unprecedented botched execution left a convicted murderer on a ventilator in critical condition. Tennessee Department of Correction Commissioner Frank Strada will leave his post this month, Governor Bill Lee said in a statement. Christa Pike, 50, on Wednesday survived two lethal injections of pentobarbital, a drug that suppresses nervous system activity.
